The Today board
History builds the board. Live moves the pieces. Your favorites are already here — set when you're leaving, and the plan rebuilds itself all day.
The three rooms
WindowsRides whose easy hour is open now and dies at a clock time — soonest deadline first. The footer names the clock. These lead the board — no banner needed; the footers are the sign.
Ride nowNever bad from where you are — no deadline, ordered as a natural walk through the park.
TonightTheir easy hour comes later. Waiting below, earliest window first.
What live can do
↑ CrownThe single best gift in the park right now rises to #1. One crown, always.
↑ EarlyA tonight-ride whose easy hour arrived early rises above the walk.
SinkBroken rides drop below everything running — back the moment they reopen.
VoiceGO NOW — 16 under typical. A confirmed gift on a ride already well-seated just says so.
Reading a row
↑ means live moved it · green means go · blue is a quiet heads-up · a dim row doesn't fit the day you set · the WINDOW footer is that ride's own clock.
Everything enters the board instantly; everything leaves only after two clean reads — one glitchy signal can never shake your plan.
Never asked
No walking speeds. No itineraries. No re-entering reservations. No refresh ritual. Open it, set your leave time, go.

How alerts work
The switches
Notifications
Master on/off for phone alerts. Off means total silence.
Apply to all rides
Uses your default rule for every ride in the parks, not just the ones you've starred. Can get chatty.
Setting your alerts
Default rule30minor less
Your baseline — ping me when a wait is your number or less (or, flipped, your number or more). Every starred ride uses this unless you give it its own.
Custom ruleCustomize
Tap Customize on any ride to give just that ride its own number.
Star a ride★
Tap the star on any ride to watch it. It pings once when the wait first crosses your rule, then sits quietly with a ✓ Hit mark and the time. It keeps watching: if the ride goes down and comes back, it re-arms and can alert you again. Stays on your list until you remove it.
Notify meNotify me
On a ride that's down, get a single ping the moment it reopens — then it parks under Back up and goes quiet. (A starred ride, by contrast, keeps watching after it's back.)
